# HAIR GLIDER Detangling Brush for Women and Kids

Glide through knots with the HAIR GLIDER, a pink detangling brush made for adults and kids alike. Its specially designed bristles work through tough snarls, so every stroke smooths your hair faster.

## Two Levels of Bristles

The dual-level bristle design teases out knots with each pass. You spend less time untangling and more time getting ready.

## Made for Busy Mornings

Detangling your own hair or helping kids rush out the door? This brush cuts down on snags and tugging, so routines run smoother.

## Works for Many Hair Types

Shoppers use it on thick, curly, and fine hair, and it's a practical choice for the whole family.

## Shop Risk-Free

Every order is backed by a 100% no-hassle return policy, so you can try it with confidence. Keep one in your bag for travel, or order extras for family members and friends. It also makes a thoughtful gift.
